findings.summary: The advertised first managed workflow is not executable from a newly created task: `task run` stops with `semantic_input_required`, but the workflow and generated bootstrap guidance omit the required `task advance` PLANNER exchange.
findings.broken_invariant: Acceptance requires complete managed and external first workflows without hidden manual transitions, while the implementation's own task-lifecycle contract requires initial planning through the external `task advance` protocol.

evidence_refs.section: README, task-lifecycle, workflow, bootstrap-guide, and generated bootstrap changes

findings.summary: The bundled website corpus remains internally contradictory: it states that `task run` resolves the initial planning episode even though the corrected lifecycle documentation says it returns `semantic_input_required`.
findings.broken_invariant: Generated public documentation must agree with the actual supervisor planning boundary and must not retain stale managed-run lifecycle claims.

missing_tests: Add an end-to-end documentation contract test that starts from `task new`, asserts `task run` returns `semantic_input_required`, and verifies that every advertised first workflow includes the required PLANNER `task advance` result exchange before managed execution.

Add a generated-corpus freshness/parity check that compares lifecycle claims in `website/static/llms-full.txt` with canonical task-lifecycle documentation and rejects the stale claim that `task run` resolves initial planning.
hidden_assumptions: A reader can infer how to resolve `semantic_input_required` from the phrase “resolve that boundary,” despite the section being presented as a copy-paste managed workflow.
Passing `docs:onboarding:check` and `docs:cli:check` proves all generated public documentation is current, although the frozen diff contains contradictory lifecycle text.
recovery_context: Rewrite the first managed/bootstrap workflow to expose the mandatory external PLANNER `task advance` exchange before `task run`, regenerate `website/static/llms-full.txt`, and add parity tests that fail on the stale planning claim.
